description: This Java class defines a BroadcastReceiver that handles specific notification-related intents, enabling or disabling message notifications and displaying toast messages based on incoming intents and remote input results.

classes.name: NotificationIntentReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for specific notification actions, toggling message display states and showing toast messages based on the received intents.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast intents, determining the action and displaying messages or toggling message enable/disable states.
